dataIntro: This permanently deletes the data listed below. Your account stays open and you can keep using ToyTrader right after.
itemToys: Toy listings that aren't part of any trade (active or past)
itemShipping: Your saved shipping info (name, phone, preferred parcel machine)
itemNotifications: Your push notification registrations, on this and every other device
itemRatings: Ratings you've given to other traders
keptNote: To preserve the other trader's history, toy listings and shipping contact details tied to a trade aren't deleted outright - your name and phone are cleared from those trades, but the trade record itself stays.
confirmData: Delete your data? This can't be undone.
successBody: Removed {{deleted}} listing(s) plus your shipping info, ratings, and complaints. {{kept}} listing(s) tied to a trade were kept.
doneNote: Done - you can safely leave this page.
accountIntro: This deletes everything listed above and permanently deletes your ToyTrader account - you'll be signed out immediately and won't be able to sign back in with it.
accountKeptNote: As above, toy listings and shipping contact details tied to a trade stay (with your name and phone removed) so the other trader's history isn't lost.
confirmAccount: Delete your account? You'll be signed out and this can't be undone.
accountDeletedBody: Your ToyTrader account and data have been removed.
